wiki.title: Donna Campbell
wiki.extract: Donna Sue Campbell (née Burrows; born September 17, 1954) is an American politician and physician who is the 25th district member of the Texas Senate. On July 31, 2012, she became the first person in Texas history to defeat an incumbent Republican senator, Jeff Wentworth of San Antonio, in a primary election.
